textRuns.value: The £ Opportunity and demand projections are MODELLED with stated assumptions: ~£3,500 average annual cost per high-risk patient; ~3.5%/yr growth in the high-risk population; avertable activity set by the on-page sliders. Inverse Care Index = need (deprivation) divided by provision (GP FTE per head). Priority Index = mean PHM risk x (11 - IMD decile). Intervention scores are expert-assigned (1-10) on impact, feasibility, cost and evidence.
